title: Affine homotopy operator h_#([[(0,1)]] × X) on compactly vanishing IM currents: integrality, locality, characterization by smooth approximations, support and the mass bound 2.27
statement: Conventions: ℝ^N = Euclid N and Hᵈ = μHE[d]. 𝒟^d(U) = TestFormOn U d (smooth d-forms with compact support in U) and 𝒟_d(U) = GeometricCurrentOn U d; ∂X = X.boundary; X − Y is pointwise on test forms. |α| = covectorEuclideanNorm α is the Euclidean coefficient norm of a covector and ‖·‖ is the operator norm. M_W(X) = X.massOn W and M(X) = X.mass = M_univ(X). An IMRep R = (M, θ, ξ) (contract structure IMRep U d) has μ_R = θ·Hᵈ⌞M = R.measure and R.action(γ) = ∫_M θ ξ(γ) dHᵈ for any d-form γ; X is IM if some IMRep represents it. X vanishes off E if X(ω) = 0 whenever tsupport ω is disjoint from E. For a map Φ and a form ω, Φ^#ω(x) := ω(Φ(x)) ∘ DΦ(x) (Lean (ω (Φ x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ Φ x)). Assume (IPF), the conclusion of the frozen statement of dor_lmb_fcd_im_pushforward, which the parent obtains by applying that declaration to the antecedent (IMS). (IPF) says the following. Let N, N', k ∈ ℕ and let R be an IMRep of degree k in univ ⊆ ℝ^N with μ_R(ℝ^N) ≠ ∞. Then there is Y : (ℝ^N → ℝ^{N'}) → 𝒟_k(ℝ^{N'}) with two properties. (a) For every Λ ∈ ℝ≥0 and every Λ-Lipschitz F, Y(F) is IM. Moreover, for every sequence of C¹ Λ-Lipschitz maps F_j → F uniformly and every ω ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^{N'}), R.action(F_j^#ω) → Y(F)(ω). (b) Y(F) = Y(F') whenever F, F' are Λ-Lipschitz and F = F' H^k⌞R.carrier-a.e. Then for every P ∈ ℕ there is an operation homot : ∀ k, (ℝ^P → ℝ^P) → (ℝ^P → ℝ^P) → 𝒟_k(ℝ^P) → 𝒟_{k+1}(ℝ^P) with the following property. Let k ∈ ℕ, Λ ∈ ℝ≥0, F, G Λ-Lipschitz, E ⊆ ℝ^P compact, and X ∈ 𝒟_k(ℝ^P) IM and vanishing off E. Then: (H1) homot k F G X is IM. (H2) homot k F G X = homot k F' G' X for all Λ-Lipschitz F', G' with F = F' and G = G' on E. (H3) Let F_j, G_j be C¹ Λ-Lipschitz with F_j → F and G_j → G uniformly, ω ∈ 𝒟^{k+1}(ℝ^P), and η_j ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^P) test forms with η_j = K_jω on E. Here K_jω(x) := ∫_0^1 (ω(F_j x + t(G_j x − F_j x)).curryLeft (G_j x − F_j x)) ∘ (DF_j(x) + t(DG_j(x) − DF_j(x))) dt. Then X(η_j) → homot k F G X(ω). (H4) homot k F G X vanishes off {F x + t(G x − F x) : x ∈ E, t ∈ [0,1]}. (H5) For every δ ∈ ℝ with dist(F x, G x) ≤ δ on E: M(homot k F G X) ≤ ofReal(δ)·(2Λ)^k·M(X).
